upgrades.name: Auto bed levelling kit
upgrades.description: A probe that maps the bed before every print, so the first layer goes down evenly. The big one for prints that won't stick.

upgrades.name: Frame stiffening braces
upgrades.description: Stops a wobbly frame swaying. Fewer layer shifts, and it can print a touch faster.

upgrades.name: Anti vibration feet
upgrades.description: Squashy feet that soak up the shaking. Cheap and cheerful, for a slightly smoother finish.

upgrades.name: Cable chain kit
upgrades.description: Tidies the wiring so nothing rubs or snags. Every part lasts a little longer.
